anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: The After wording moved contract from fails to holds: Case G now shows the Current/Proposed wording pair with /health and /status, then exactly three path-free sentences directly above Pick one covering the current requirement, what moving the address gains, and that the existing address can already return the build version. Before had only a proposal summary and a one-sentence reason that contained /health. That same change moved authority, because Before's G lacked the three contract sentences the fact requires. No fact that Before kept was lost, but two spots are fragile. In Case A, the deliver row now says "one more 15-minute window and continue until merge is offered", which could be read as open-ended watching, and "the repair and sync limits stay the same" covers no cap extension but not that no round is charged; wording such as "watch for exactly one more window; no repair or sync attempt is used and neither limit is raised" would pin it down. In Case G, the claim that the existing address can already serve the build version sits inside the second (cost/gain) sentence, while the third sentence only says a repair under the current requirement gives the same result; making the third sentence state that capability directly would keep the three roles distinct. Keep the endpoint paths confined to the wording pair and the row consequences free of argument, as they are now.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: The only fact that moved is contract, and it moved as intended. Before showed no current/proposed wording pair and put /health in its explanation and recommendation sentences. After shows the two wordings with /health and /status, then gives three path-free sentences directly above Pick one, with preserve contract first, accept contract change and stop after it, and no report or other argument. The weakest part is the second sentence: "unnecessary for the goal" only implies what the move costs or gains, so the wording should ask for it to be stated outright (for example, that moving the address gains nothing for the goal and costs a spec amendment). Every A-F fact held in both outputs, but three After drifts are worth guarding against. "You cannot approve your own PR" is now repeated in every own-PR report; it is harmless here, but it is standing prose that could leak into G. The Case A recommendation reason dropped the check name ("the required check" rather than test_unit), which holds only because the paragraph above names it; keep the name in the reason. The Case E preview changed from 'Replace "Reports uptime" with "Reports the build version"' to a labelled arrow line with curly quotes; it still reads as the exact old-to-new text, but tell the skill to reproduce the drafted preview verbatim. Neither output states outright that the extra watch window charges no round; saying "charges no repair or sync round and extends neither cap" would make pending unambiguous.
